Just for a quick description. Both Josiah Warren (American Individualist Anarchist) and Piotr Kropotkin (Russian Communist Anarchist) at various times proposed the same basic idea.

That in a world of increasing concentration of capital the appropriate response is the creation of rival and directly competitive corporate entities by the working classes. Both Josiah and Piotr proposed the form of an incorporated township owned jointly by the residents of that township.
